verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bento's MCP server can look up subscribers, create broadcasts, and track events (bento-docs-5), and a generic 'describe what you want, AI will build it' feature (bento-docs-10), but no documentation ties this to translating a plain-language description into an actual audience segment via the API/MCP surface — segment filtering is described only as manual tag/date-based filters (bento-docs-8).
